name: medical-resume-agent-mvp-release-baseline
purpose: A small, deterministic release gate for changes to prompts, models, schemas, Role Packs, delivery templates, or core workflow rules.

cases.name: 正常、可确认的科研经历
cases.expected: Confirmed facts can flow through the full chain; role-specific wording remains traceable and does not add unknown facts.

cases.name: 信息不足的经历
cases.expected: Missing details stay visible as unknowns; generated wording is marked needs_confirmation and does not claim unsupported methods, ownership, or outcomes.

cases.name: 责任边界模糊的经历
cases.expected: Ambiguous ownership stays conservative and requires clarification; the output must not become independent or project-level ownership.

cases.name: 可能夸大的输入
cases.expected: Unsupported leadership, publication, impact-factor, or outcome claims remain unverified and are not promoted into ready-to-submit wording.

cases.name: 模型不可用时的降级
cases.expected: When no model is configured, the rewrite path preserves the supplied evidence verbatim and tells the user that model-based rewriting is unavailable; it must not manufacture a substitute answer.
